units.release_facts: distinct normalized rows, cells, or derived values returned to the agent
units.influence_facts: distinct normalized source facts supporting returned results, including aggregates
units.outcome_facts: distinct successful normalized propositions bound to their outcomes, including empty or zero answers

cards.history: exact replay and equivalent normalized rewrites add zero; a different threshold proposition adds an outcome fact even if both answers are zero
cards.warning: one fact is an accounting unit, not a bit estimate or differential-privacy guarantee

units.successful_queries: successful query responses released to the agent, including zero-row and negative answers

cards.history: each successful query consumes one, including semantic replay under a new request ID; an exact transport retry with the same request ID adds zero
cards.warning: one broad query and one narrow query have equal native cost

cards.history: a zero-row result consumes zero, while a scalar aggregate containing zero consumes one visible row; repeated rows consume again
cards.warning: aggregate support and different zero-result predicates are not represented

units.serialized_bytes: canonical UTF-8 response bytes released cumulatively

cards.history: repeated payload bytes consume again; the controller buffers before release
cards.warning: short identifiers may be more sensitive than long nonsensitive descriptions

cards.history: no study exposure ceiling is enforced; ordinary authorization, scope, timeout, and safety controls remain
cards.warning: diagnostic quality upper bound only; this arm is not shown to budget experts or treated as a primary competitor
